product.description: Monoprice™Cat6A U/FTP Ethernet Extension Cable RJ45 Male to Female (with PCB Jack 3µ), 26AWG, Stranded Bare Copper, CM PVC JacketEffortlessly Extend and Protect Your Ethernet ConnectionsThe Monoprice Cat6A Ethernet Extension Cable offers a simple, effective way to extend your wired network connection without compromising performance. Featuring a male‑to‑female RJ45 design, this extension cable helps reduce wear on primary Ethernet ports while adding flexibility to tight or hard‑to‑reach spaces. Built with 26AWG stranded bare copper conductors and a durable CM‑rated PVC jacket, it delivers reliable signal transmission for demanding data applications. The unshielded U/FTP construction provides excellent performance in environments with minimal interference, while the integrated PCB‑mounted female jack with 3µ gold‑plated contacts ensures long‑term durability and secure connectivity.
